about.title: About Corona-Norco USD
about.content: Corona-Norco Unified School District serves students and families in Riverside County's Inland Empire, including Corona, Norco, and Eastvale-area communities. The district calendar is more complex than a single traditional calendar because CNUSD publishes separate elementary and secondary track calendar PDFs.

about.title: How to Use This Corona-Norco USD Calendar
about.content: Use this page as a combined CNUSD calendar reference, then verify the calendar that matches your student's school level and track. Elementary families should check the Elementary School Track Calendar for A, B, C, D, or Traditional track dates. Secondary families should check the Secondary School Track Calendar for Orange Grove, Intermediate, High School, or JFK Middle College dates.

customSections.label: Corona-Norco USD Track Calendar Context
customSections.content: CNUSD calendar planning is track-based. Some elementary schools use A, B, C, and D tracks, while other elementary campuses use a Traditional track. Secondary calendars are organized separately for Orange Grove, Intermediate, High School, and JFK Middle College schedules. Families should not rely on a single first day, last day, minimum day, or early dismissal date until they know the student's campus and track.

planningTips.title: Corona-Norco USD Calendar Usage Tips
content: Use both the elementary and secondary PDF calendars when comparing districtwide CNUSD dates.
Confirm your student's track before planning around minimum days, early dismissal days, conference days, or track-change dates.
Watch common no-school dates such as Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, winter holidays, MLK Jr. Day, Lincoln's Day, Presidents Day, Memorial Day, and Juneteenth.
Use the PDF for official review and the ICS file for a one-time personal calendar import.

districtFaqs.q: Why does Corona-Norco USD have more than one calendar PDF?
districtFaqs.a: CNUSD publishes separate elementary and secondary track calendar PDFs. Elementary schools may follow A, B, C, D, or Traditional tracks, while secondary schools follow Orange Grove, Intermediate, High School, or JFK Middle College schedules.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Corona-Norco USD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official CNUSD school calendars and bell schedules page, the matching elementary or secondary PDF, and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with CNUSD.
